scope: LP2-00--55, headings included; retain only alphabet runes; overlapping windows.

boundary_modes.page: Never pair across pages; within-page non-runes are removed.
boundary_modes.joined: Concatenate all filtered pages in numerical order, including across empty pages.

expectation: Uniform random permutations preserving each stream's rune counts. Sum f*(f-1)/N per nonempty stream. This is an expectation, not a p-value.

multiplicative_ea_constraint.scope: A doublet is equivalent to plaintext EA=28 only for this equation with nonzero keys modulo prime 29. No language frequency or key generator is assumed.
